paper.title: Communication-Corruption Coupling and Verification in Cooperative Multi-Objective Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Cooperative N-agent stochastic multi-objective bandits with global corruption budget Gamma (general UCB-type protocol / (S1) raw-sample / (S2) sufficient-statistic / (S3) recommendation-only sharing)
settings.out_of_scope_reason: Multi-objective (vector-valued) rewards, evaluated through a known monotone scalarization.
unmapped: Vector rewards in [0,1]^d; regret measured under a known coordinate-wise nondecreasing L-Lipschitz (l_inf) scalarization phi, which the learner knows
Team regret summed over N agents, each pulling one arm per round
Communication protocol (raw samples, sufficient statistics or recommendations) determines the effective corruption Gamma_eff
Corruption budget measured in l_inf norm summed over agent-rounds; corrupted observations are projected onto [0,1]^d
Optional verification: at most nu clean observations system-wide
The confidence radius uses the arm-wise effective corruption Gamma_eff,k, so the learner knows it
settings.definition_quote: In each of $T$ rounds, each of $N$ agents selects an arm, the environment generates a clean reward vector, and an adversary perturbs the observed feedback subject to a global corruption budget $\Gamma$. ... $\sum_{t=1}^T \sum_{n=1}^N \|C_{n,t}\|\le \Gamma$.

settings.name_in_paper: Cooperative multi-objective bandits with corruption under (S1) raw-sample append-all sharing (lower bound)
settings.out_of_scope_reason: Multi-objective (vector-valued) rewards with scalarization; the proof reduces to d=1.
unmapped: Team regret over N agents under a monotone L-Lipschitz scalarization
Protocol is restricted to (S1) raw-sample sharing with append-all local estimators
settings.definition_quote: Under (S1) raw-sample sharing with append-all local estimators, there exist instances and adversaries with $\sum_{t,n}|C_{n,t}|\le \Gamma$ ...

algorithms.name: Cooperative robust UCB-type protocol (corruption-enlarged radii with upper-corner scalarized index)
S3-Cert (recommendation-only sharing with certified override from verified samples)

source.label: thm:meta_team_ub
source.quote: Fix $\delta\in(0,1)$. On an event of probability at least $1-\delta$, any cooperative UCB-type protocol using radii $\beta_{j,k}(t)$ satisfies $\Reg_\phi^{\mathrm{team}}(T) \le c L\Big(\sqrt{KNT\log(2dKNT/\delta)} + \Gamma_{\mathrm{eff}}\log(1+NT)\Big)$, for a universal constant $c>0$.

results.notes: Team regret summed over N agents. The radii use the arm-wise effective corruption Gamma_eff,k, so the algorithm effectively knows the corruption.

symbols.L_phi: Lipschitz constant of the scalarization phi

results.notes: Gamma is the paper's global corruption budget, mapped to C. The high-probability qualifier is inherited from Theorem 1.

symbols.L_phi: Lipschitz constant of the scalarization phi

source.label: cor:S2S3_rate
source.quote: Under (S2) or (S3), $\Gamma_{\mathrm{eff}}=\Gamma$, hence we have $\Reg_\phi^{\mathrm{team}}(T)\le \widetilde O\big(L\sqrt{KNT}+L\Gamma\big)$.

results.notes: The high-probability qualifier is inherited from Theorem 1.

bound.regime: N*Gamma <= N*T (otherwise replace N*Gamma by min{N*Gamma, NT})

conditions: cooperative protocols using (S1) raw-sample sharing with append-all local estimators
there exist instances and adversaries (Bernoulli instances, d=1, phi(x)=x in the proof)

source.label: thm:amp_lb
source.quote: Under (S1) raw-sample sharing with append-all local estimators, there exist instances and adversaries with $\sum_{t,n}|C_{n,t}|\le \Gamma$ such that $\bE\big[\Reg_\phi^{\mathrm{team}}(T)\big]\ge c_1\sqrt{KNT}+c_2 N\Gamma$ for universal constants $c_1,c_2>0$.

results.notes: Regret is defined through means, so this is pseudo-regret. The proof satisfies the budget only with constant probability and is informal.

symbols.L_phi: Lipschitz constant of the scalarization phi
symbols.Reg_clean: clean-case regret overhead Reg^clean_comm(K,N,T) of the underlying coordination protocol

conditions: (S3) recommendation-only sharing with optional verified certificates, at most nu verifications

source.label: thm:verified_sharing
source.quote: (Always-valid robust baseline) For all instances and adversaries with budget~\eqref{eq:global_budget}, $\Reg_\phi^{\mathrm{team}}(T)\le \widetilde O\big(L\cdot \Reg^{\mathrm{clean}}_{\mathrm{comm}}(K,N,T)+L\Gamma\big)$

results.notes: Part 1 of Theorem 3. The bound depends on an unspecified protocol term, and the probability is stated as high-probability in the proof.
